kql:
imProcessCreate
| where (CommandLine has "user" or CommandLine has "group")
| where (CommandLine has "/do" or CommandLine has "/domain")

imDns
| where DnsResponseCodeName != "NOERROR"
| summarize ErrorCount = count(), FirstErrorTime = min(TimeGenerated), LastErrorTime = max(TimeGenerated) by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| top 25 by ErrorCount desc

imNetworkSession
| summarize Count = count() by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| summarize StdevCount = stdev(Count), AvgCount = avg(Count) by SrcIpAddr, bin(TimeGenerated, 14d)
| extend AvgDeviation = StdevCount / AvgCount
| where AvgDeviation > 50

imNetworkSession
| summarize CurrentCount = count() by SrcIpAddr, SrcPortNumber, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| join kind=inner (
    imNetworkSession
    | summarize BaselineCount = count() by SrcIpAddr, SrcPortNumber, bin(TimeGenerated, 14d)
    | extend BaselineAvg = BaselineCount / 14
) on SrcIpAddr, SrcPortNumber
| extend Margin = CurrentCount - BaselineAvg
| where Margin > 50
